description: Read one Skwirl note by its exact note_id from search_skwirl, recent_skwirl or list_skwirl_mentions. Returns stored Markdown including summary, next step, transcript and source permalink when available; a missing or inaccessible ID returns a no-match message. Each successful call increments the note's open counter, so repeated reads have an additional side effect. Use search_skwirl to find relevant notes, recent_skwirl to browse newest saves, or list_skwirl_mentions to find named entities before opening one. Usage examples: get_skwirl_note({"note_id":"a1b2c3d4e5f67890"}). Returns text.

note_id.description: Nonempty string ID returned by search_skwirl, recent_skwirl or list_skwirl_mentions; use it verbatim. Example: a1b2c3d4e5f67890.

name: get_skwirl_note
